title: Compose Tags With merge()
scenario: Use merge() to combine a shared tag map with resource-specific tags.
constraints: Keep Project, Environment, ManagedBy in the shared map.

focus.title: Complete the locals block
focus.todo: Build local.common_tags with merge() and reuse it on the bucket.

hints.why: Built-in functions keep transformations declarative. They make naming, tagging and collection manipulation repeatable instead of relying on manually maintained strings.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `locals`. Build local.common_tags with merge() and reuse it on the bucket. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use functions when you need to transform a value in place: join a list, change case, merge maps, build a formatted name, or choose a fallback.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `locals`. Use this code shape: common_tags. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.project_name`, `var.environment`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
